articles.title: The Great AI Disappointment
articles.content:
如果你觉得这个故事值得分享，请帮忙传播。我们必须做得更好。这不是我们子孙后代应该有的未来。

如果你能帮忙把这篇文章分享给朋友、家人、同事或熟人，或者转发到其他平台，我会非常感激。

在这份文件中，我将阐述我的“AI大失望论”。

坦白说，我不是最具说服力的故事讲述者，只是一名博主，一个不复存在的网络时代的遗物。那是一个由人类主导的网络，可能再也无法重现。随着年龄的增长，以及撰写和整理了数百篇关于AI的文章，我注意到世界对生成式AI的态度正在发生变化。你可以阅读报告，但真相往往隐藏在炒作背后的沉默共识中。过度投资AI所带来的成本开始侵蚀社会结构、法治和社会秩序。现实尚未追上新的变化。互联网正在“大量低质内容”的重压下士气低落。但我们别无选择，这个劳动力市场令人窒息。你不禁开始怀疑，这一切是否是经过精心设计的。这种疯狂中有一种金融脆弱性，对普通人造成了成本。目睹这一切令人失望。AI如今已成为贪婪的代名词，正在侵蚀我们曾认为理所当然且永远存在的社会契约。让我在这篇文章中尝试解释一下：简单来说，AI硬件不应该被放在人类福祉之上。

ChatGPT上线已近四年。如果当初你告诉我，AI会创造一个更碎片化的互联网，带来更空洞、更令人失望的体验，损害人类文化，降低文化素养（我们阅读量减少），成为白领失业的推手，并对人类福祉造成伤害，经济效益可疑，我可能不会相信。但在伪装中存在着重量，有一种执念告诉我这并不是真相。人们感到不满，AI不仅未能实现其承诺的潜力，还推高了通货膨胀，并带来了难以量化的经济、心理、地缘政治和社会学方面的成本。在OpenAI、风险投资和大型科技公司数十亿美元的资金、游说和公关的推动下，我们被引入歧途。这开始损害我们的集体未来。生成式AI看起来是欺骗性的，其大规模影响似乎是有害的。

生成式AI作为一种运动和投资，带来的分裂多于统一或赋能。生活在一个充斥着AI垃圾和工作垃圾的世界中令人羞耻和深感不安。这不是你一个人的感觉，我们都感受到了。它不是一项好的技术。它加速腐败的速度比推动法治、公平或展示真实增长更快。为一个失败的承诺投入资金的连锁反应可能是灾难性的。

它没有像显著的通用技术（GPT）那样被社会采用或普及。它没有创造能够引导我们文明，作为一个物种进入更有意义或更美好未来的价值。这很重要，必须说出来。我并不以现实地表达这一点为荣。生成式AI不是ChatGPT突然出现时我们所期待的那样。随着模型变得更大、更复杂，支出飙升至天文数字，我们曾期待切实的好处，并认为对社会的危害将得到明显缓解，得到谨慎的监管，垄断行为也将受到某些规则的约束。但技术的有害影响正在加速，而技术展示的真实价值却不够。到2020年代末，它将失控。美国人不是这种程度的财富和人工权力的良好守护者。但他们确实擅长构建一种技术庞氏骗局，以膨胀他们日益具备反乌托邦特征的互联网的公司垄断地位。去哪里找“退出”按钮？去哪里找重置开关？生成式AI正在误导我们。
articles.summary:
If you think this is a story worth sharing, please spread the word. We need to do better. This is not the right future for our descendents.

Share

If you can do me the favor of sharing this article with a friend, family member, coworker or acquaintance, it would mean the world to me. Or restacking it or sharing it elsewhere.

In this document I provide my Great AI Disappointment thesis.

Listen to the Essay 🎧: 25 minutes, 37.

I’ll be honest I’m not the most persuasive storyteller, I’m just a blogger and a relic of an internet that no longer exists. A human led internet that may never exist again, the way things are going. But as I get a bit older and after writing and curating hundreds of articles about AI, I’m noticing a shift in the world with regards to Generative AI specifically. You can read reports, but the truth is somewhere in the silent consensus beneath the hype. The costs of the over-investment in this AI cycle are beginning to gnaw at the social fabric, rule of law and the social order. The way things were has not caught up to the new reality. The internet is demoralized under the weight of all of the AI slop. But there’s nowhere to go, this labor market is punishing. And you have to begin to wonder if it’s all by careful design. There’s a financial fragility to the madness and a cost to real people. It’s disappointing to witness. AI is now synonymous with greed and a deterioration of the social contract we used to take for granted and believed would always exist. Let me try and explain in this essay: put plainly, AI hardware should not be put ahead of the well-being of people.

We are nearly four years since ChatGPT first went live. If you would have told me that AI would create a more fractured internet, with a more hollow and disappointing experience, hurting human culture, literacy (we read less), a force for white collar deskilling, and detrimental to human well-being with questionable economic benefits, I probably wouldn’t have believed you. But there’s a weight in pretending and a nagging feeling that this isn't it. And people are upset, not only has AI not reached its promised potential - it’s increasing inflation and comes with a rising cost in economic, psychological and even geopolitical and sociological terms difficult to quantify. With all the Billions of dollars in funding OpenAI, Venture Capital and BigTech marketing, lobbying and PR, we have been led astray. It’s beginning to harm our collective future. Generative AI appears fraudulent and its impact appears to be harmful at scale.

Generative AI as a movement and investment, has been more divisive than unifying or empowering. It’s humiliating and deeply unsettling to live in a world of AI slop and work slop. It’s not just you, we all feel it. It’s not been a good technology. It’s increasing corruption faster than it’s siding with any sense of rule of law, fairness or even demonstrating real growth. The cascade of funding a failed promise could be devastating.

It’s not being adopted or diffusing into society as would a significant general purpose technology (GPT). It’s not building value that’s leading us as a civilization, as a species, to a more meaningful or better future. It’s important to say this aloud. I take no great pride in trying to frame this realistically. Generative AI isn’t what we were promised when ChatGPT suddenly appeared. As models became larger and more sophisticated and spending increased astronomically we were expecting tangible benefits and that the dangers to society would be demonstrably mitigated, carefully regulated and monopolies given some ground rules. But the detrimental impact of the tech are accelerating faster than the tech can show real value. By the late 2020s, it will be out of control. Americans are not good custodians of this degree of financial and artificial power. But they sure know how to build a technological ponzi scheme to inflate the corporate monopolies of their increasingly dystopian internet. Where’s the “opt-out” button? Where’s the reset switch? Generative AI is leading us astray.

Degrading Culture and Revamping Economic Opportunity
